summary.request: We resell cloud services with usage-based subscription billing. The monthly usage file from our supplier has a data center region column, and the region must be shown on the customer contract invoice lines and on the posted invoices. Each subscription line also has a support level that customers can change when the contract is renewed. The new support level must apply to the renewed term.
summary.business-process: Carry a data center region from the supplier's usage file to customer contract invoice lines and posted invoices, and renew a per-subscription-line support level through contract renewal, both in the Subscription Billing app (usage-based billing and contract renewal).

objects.purpose: Holds the data center region of each usage data billing row, copied from the imported usage line before the row is inserted. Nothing copies by field number in the usage path, so the value is assigned in a subscriber.

data-flow.note: Data Exch. Field Mapping in the supplier's Data Exchange Definition maps the region column to the spare Text1 field (or a field added to Usage Data Generic Import, see q-region-import-field). Run by the Create Imported Lines step of Usage Data Import.
Assigned in OnBeforInsertUsageDataBilling from UsageDataGenericImportGlobal; no Modify, the app inserts right after.

In OnBeforeInsertSalesLineFromContractLine, read open Usage Data Billing rows with the app's filters (Partner Customer, contract no. and line no. from TempBillingLine, Document Type None, empty Document No.) and apply the winner rule of q-region-winner. Covers contract credit memos created by the same routine.
Standard posting (InitFromSalesLine); same field number and type.

data-flow.to: Sales Cr.Memo Line, Sales Shipment Line, Return Receipt Line, Sales Line Archive
data-flow.note: Standard posting and archiving; same field number and type. Subject to q-mirror-targets.
In OnAfterInsertSubscriptionLine, Get the subscription line by SalesSubscriptionLine."Subscription Line Entry No.", assign and Modify (the line is already inserted).

data-flow.from: User on the renewal quote or order
data-flow.note: The customer's new support level is entered on the renewal sales subscription line. The page that shows these lines is not named by any opened article (see unresolved).
In OnAfterCopyFromSalesSubscriptionLine on table Subscription Line, run by Post Sub. Contract Renewal when the renewal order is posted (no invoice is posted for renewal lines).
The app copies the temporary line into the planned line with TransferFields; same field number and type.
In OnBeforeUpdateSubscriptionLineFromPlannedSubscriptionLine, assign without Modify. Takes effect when the planned line is applied, not when the renewal order is posted.

subscriptions.purpose: Copy the region from UsageDataGenericImportGlobal (Text1 or the added field) to the Usage Data Billing row before its insert.
guards: Assign only; no Modify (the app calls Insert(true) right after).
Exit unless UsageDataBilling.Partner is Customer, if the region is for the customer side only (q-vendor-side).
Copy with CopyStr to the target length.

subscriptions.purpose: Read the open Usage Data Billing rows of the contract line and set the region on the contract invoice line before it is inserted.
guards: Filter Usage Data Billing exactly as the app does: Partner Customer, Subscription Contract No. and Line No. from TempBillingLine, Document Type None, Document No. empty; never by the sales line's Document No.
Apply the agreed winner/combination rule when several rows cover one invoice line (q-region-winner).
Assign only, no Modify; never patch the line after insert (Document Change Management).
No UI: billing may run from Auto Contract Billing in a job queue.

subscriptions.purpose: Prefill the renewal quote's sales subscription line with the current support level so the customer sees and can change it.
guards: Exit if the subscription line cannot be found by Subscription Line Entry No.
The record is already inserted: assign then Modify.

subscriptions.purpose: Copy the renewed support level from the sales subscription line to the temporary subscription line, from which TransferFields fills the planned line.
Apply the renewed support level to the subscription line when the planned line is applied.
guards: Assign only; the app archives old values and calls Modify(false) right after.

subscriptions.purpose: Change the update rule so a renewal whose price, discount, calculation base and billing rhythm are unchanged but whose support level changed waits until the subscription line is billed to its end date, so the new level applies to the renewed term only (subject to q-support-level-timing).
guards: Only defer when the support level differs and the line is not yet billed up to its end date; leave all other cases to the app's rule.
Parameter list must be confirmed in the Subscription Billing symbols before implementation.

lifecycle.step: In the supplier's Data Exchange Definition, add a Data Exch. Field Mapping from the region column to Usage Data Generic Import Text1 (or the added field). Decide whether the app ships this mapping or the customer maintains it (q-region-import-field).
Add a dependency on the Subscription Billing app (publisher Microsoft, id 3099ffc7-4cf7-4df6-9b96-7e4bc2bb587c).
Set DataClassification = CustomerContent on every added table extension field (Usage Region, Support Level); table extensions have no table-level value to inherit.

Keep both subscriber codeunits free of Confirm, Message-only feedback, RunModal and other UI: contract billing can run from Auto Contract Billing in a job queue, and an error stops the run while documents committed before it stay.
Page fields for Usage Region and Support Level get tooltip text on the table field (inherited by bound page fields from runtime 13.0 / BC24) or on the page for earlier targets.

tests.given: A usage data supplier with a Data Exchange Definition mapping the region column to Text1, a customer subscription with a usage-based subscription line, and a usage file row with region WEU
tests.when: Usage Data Import runs Create Imported Lines, Process Imported Lines and Create Usage Data Billing
tests.then: The customer-side Usage Data Billing row has Usage Region WEU

tests.given: Processed Usage Data Billing rows with region WEU for a customer contract line
tests.when: Create Billing Documents creates the contract invoice
tests.then: The sales line for that contract line has Usage Region WEU, set before insert (no Document Change Management error)

tests.given: A contract invoice whose line has Usage Region WEU
tests.then: The Sales Invoice Line has Usage Region WEU

tests.given: A contract credit memo line and an archived sales line carrying a region (for the targets kept after q-mirror-targets)
tests.when: The credit memo is posted and the document is archived
tests.then: Sales Cr.Memo Line, Return Receipt Line/Sales Shipment Line where created, and Sales Line Archive carry the same region

tests.given: Two open Usage Data Billing rows for one contract line with different regions and charge periods
tests.then: The invoice line carries the region chosen by the agreed rule (q-region-winner)

tests.given: A usage file row linked to both customer and vendor usage-based subscription lines
tests.then: Only the customer-side row gets the region (or both, per q-vendor-side)

tests.given: A billing template run by Auto Contract Billing from a job queue entry
tests.when: The job creates contract invoices for lines with usage regions
tests.then: Invoices are created with regions and no UI callback error occurs

tests.given: A subscription line with Support Level SILVER and a Sub. Contract Renewal Line for it
tests.when: Create Sub. Contract Renewal creates the renewal quote
tests.then: The Sales Subscription Line has Support Level SILVER

tests.given: A renewal order whose sales subscription line has Support Level GOLD, for a subscription line billed up to its end date
tests.then: The planned line is applied and the Subscription Line has Support Level GOLD for the renewed term

tests.given: A renewal order changing the support level to GOLD (and price), for a subscription line not yet billed to its end date
tests.when: The renewal order is posted, then the last contract invoice of the old term is posted
tests.then: After order posting the Subscription Line keeps the old level and the Planned Subscription Line holds GOLD; after the old term's last invoice is posted the Subscription Line has GOLD

tests.given: A renewal that changes only the support level (price, discount, calculation base and billing rhythm unchanged) for a line not billed to its end date
tests.then: The subscription line keeps the old support level until it is billed to its end date (OnCheckPerformSubscriptionLineUpdate guard)

dependencies.reason: Extends Usage Data Billing, Subscription Line, Sales Subscription Line and Planned Subscription Line and subscribes to Create Usage Data Billing, Create Billing Documents, Create Sub. Contract Renewal and Post Sub. Contract Renewal events.

knowledge.used-for: Region path from the usage file through Usage Data Billing to the contract invoice line.
constraints: Map the region column to a spare field such as Text1 (or an added Usage Data Generic Import field) in the supplier's Data Exch. Field Mapping.
Copy to Usage Data Billing in OnBeforInsertUsageDataBilling without Modify; check Partner if the value is customer-side only.
In OnBeforeInsertSalesLineFromContractLine read Usage Data Billing with the app's filters (Partner Customer, contract no./line no. from TempBillingLine, Document Type None, empty Document No.).
The design must say which value wins, or how values are combined, when one invoice line covers many usage rows.
Nothing copies by field number in this path; do not assign in OnAfterCreateUsageDataBillingFromTempSubscriptionLine; do not read rows by the sales line's Document No.

knowledge.used-for: Subscription Billing dependency, posted-line mirroring of contract invoice lines, and credit memos following the same path.
constraints: A design that extends Subscription Billing needs the dependency on app 3099ffc7-4cf7-4df6-9b96-7e4bc2bb587c, publisher Microsoft.
Posting copies the sales line to Sales Invoice Line with TransferFields: use the same number and type on sales and posted line tables.
Credit memos follow the same path.
Do not patch the sales line later with Modify(true).

knowledge.used-for: Setting the region before the contract invoice line is inserted, and background-run constraints.
constraints: Decide every locked value before the document exists; line values go in OnBeforeInsertSalesLineFromContractLine.
Do not adjust the created invoice afterwards with Modify(true) or Modify(false).
Subscribers in this path must not need UI, because billing can run in a job queue; an error stops the run but committed documents stay.

knowledge.used-for: Renewal path for the support level through the renewal quote, planned subscription line and subscription line update.
constraints: Add the field to Subscription Line, Sales Subscription Line and Planned Subscription Line, with the same number and type on the subscription line and planned line.
Fill the quote in OnAfterInsertSubscriptionLine (read the subscription line by Subscription Line Entry No., assign, Modify).
Copy in OnAfterCopyFromSalesSubscriptionLine; TransferFields carries it to the planned line.
Apply in OnBeforeUpdateSubscriptionLineFromPlannedSubscriptionLine without Modify.
The new value takes effect when the planned line is applied, not when the order is posted; use OnCheckPerformSubscriptionLineUpdate to change the update rule.
Do not write the subscription line in OnAfterInsertPlannedSubscriptionLineFromSalesSubscriptionLine; do not subscribe to sales invoice posting events for renewals.

knowledge.used-for: Process map: selected the Subscription Billing row (usage data, set before insert, renewal) and the shared rows (mirrored definitions, privacy, tests, upgrade back-fill question).
constraints: Open every linked article for the stages chosen.
Whether a field should reach a stage the request does not name is a question for the requester; one question per group of stages.
Do not fill other records with subscribers that modify them after posting.

knowledge.used-for: Mirroring the Sales Line region on posted line tables and the line archive.
constraints: Same field number, name, type and length on the source and every target table the plan needs: Sales Shipment Line, Sales Invoice Line, Sales Cr.Memo Line, Return Receipt Line and Sales Line Archive, unless the plan states a document type never needs it.
No subscriber needed for these stages; keep mirrored fields non-editable on posted tables.

knowledge.used-for: Posted line stages and the page extensions and tests each stage needs.
constraints: Posted lines and Sales Line Archive are reached by TransferFields from Sales Line: same rule on the line tables.
Name the page extensions that show the field and a test that posts a document and reads the value back from every target.

knowledge.used-for: Type and length of every mirrored field (region on sales/posted lines; support level on subscription and planned lines).
constraints: Define mirrored fields with the exact same field number, data type and length on every table in the cascade, at creation time.

knowledge.used-for: Data classification of the added fields.
constraints: Every Normal field added in a tableextension must set its own DataClassification matching the data stored; never SystemMetadata for customer data.

knowledge.used-for: Test fixtures for customers, items and sales documents.
constraints: Build fixtures with the test Library codeunits (LibrarySales, LibraryInventory, LibraryRandom), parents before dependents, validating foreign keys.

knowledge.used-for: Billing subscribers run in background job queue sessions.
constraints: No Confirm, RunModal, Page.Run, Report.Run or Message-only feedback in code run by the job queue; let failures propagate.

constraints: From runtime 13.0 (BC24) define tooltip text on the table field and let bound page fields inherit it; before that, add page-level tooltips. Applies from BC24 for inheritance.

open-questions.question: One contract invoice line can cover several usage data billing rows (several imported lines or charge periods). If their regions differ, which region is shown: the latest charge period, the first, or should the line be split / the values combined?

Should the region column be mapped to the spare Usage Data Generic Import Text1 field or to a new field added to Usage Data Generic Import, and will the app ship the Data Exch. Field Mapping or will each customer configure it on the supplier's definition?
What is the format and maximum length of the supplier's region value (for example a code like WEU or a free-text name), and should it relate to a region master table?

Is the region needed only on customer invoices, or also on vendor-side usage data billing rows and vendor contract invoices (which would use OnBeforeInsertPurchaseLineFromContractLine and purchase mirror tables)?

Besides Sales Invoice Line, should the region also be kept on Sales Cr.Memo Line, Sales Shipment Line, Return Receipt Line and Sales Line Archive (the mirroring rule includes them by default), and should it flow back when a posted invoice is copied or corrected?
May users change the region on a contract invoice line before posting, or must it stay as imported?
What are the possible support levels: a fixed list (enum) or a code table maintained by users, and does a level carry other data such as price?
How is the support level set when a subscription line is first created (from the sales order, the item's subscription package, or manually on the contract)?

If a renewal changes only the support level and the old term is not yet fully billed, the app would apply it immediately. Should the design defer it to the renewed term (OnCheckPerformSubscriptionLineUpdate), as designed, accepting that the subscription line then cannot be selected for another renewal while it waits?
Should the support level also appear on contract invoice lines and posted invoices (billing line path), or only on the subscription line?
Do existing subscription lines need an initial support level, and existing open usage data billing rows a region, through upgrade or install code, or do they stay blank?
